My plot is 1.36 hectares of maize here in Mwanza, and I am intercropping with pigeon pea and beans to help the soil and feed my family. If I get the FISP coupon this year I will buy NPK and urea — without it, fertilizer is too expensive, but I will try to put at least a little on the maize because our soils are tired. I keep a few goats and chickens, so I spread their manure near the homestead plot. I will use hybrid seed if the coupon covers it; otherwise I recycle seed from last season. No pesticides, no irrigation — we depend on the rains.
